name: SSS-8
shortDescription: 8-item DSM-5 validated scale measuring past-week physical symptom burden (GI, pain, headaches, fatigue, sleep).
timeframe: During the past 7 days, how much have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
citation: Gierk B, Kohlmann S, Kroenke K, et al. JAMA Intern Med. 2014;174(3):399-407.

questions.text: Pain in your arms, legs, or joints
Chest pain or shortness of breath
Feeling tired or having low energy

scoring.formulaDescription: Sum of all 8 items scored 0–4 each (range 0–32). Gierk et al. (2014) percentile-based severity cutoffs: 0–3 No to Minimal, 4–7 Low, 8–11 Medium, 12–15 High, and 16–32 Very High somatic symptom burden.
